{"program":"domain(person,[ashley,alliebear,margaret,kyree]).

% Ashley participates in conferences.
axiom(s1, participates_in_conferences(ashley)).

% Alliebear does not publish her findings.
axiom(s2, not(publishes_findings(alliebear))).

% If Margaret earns recognition, then she either publishes papers or receives awards (or both).
axiom(s3, rule([earns_recognition(margaret)], or(publishes_papers(margaret),receives_awards(margaret)))).

% Alliebear either works independently or collaborates with experts, but not both.
axiom(s4, xor(works_independently(alliebear),collaborates_with_experts(alliebear))).

% Anyone who makes breakthroughs either publishes their findings or advances knowledge (or both).
axiom(s5, rule([makes_breakthroughs(X)], or(publishes_findings(X),advances_knowledge(X)))).

% Alliebear does not publish papers.
axiom(s6, not(publishes_papers(alliebear))).

% Alliebear does not advance knowledge.
axiom(s7, not(advances_knowledge(alliebear))).

% If Alliebear either mentors students or joins research teams (but not both), then she collaborates with experts.
axiom(s8, rule([xor(mentors_students(alliebear),joins_research_teams(alliebear))], collaborates_with_experts(alliebear))).

% Alliebear works independently.
axiom(s9, works_independently(alliebear)).

% Alliebear either participates in conferences or delivers lectures, but not both.
axiom(s10, xor(participates_in_conferences(alliebear),delivers_lectures(alliebear))).

% Alliebear pursues a PhD.
axiom(s11, pursues_phd(alliebear)).

% Anyone who collaborates with experts or produces innovative research can make breakthroughs.
axiom(s12, rule([or(collaborates_with_experts(X),produces_innovative_research(X))], makes_breakthroughs(X))).

% If Alliebear is a dedicated scientist, then she produces innovative research and earns recognition.
axiom(s13, rule([dedicated_scientist(alliebear)], and(produces_innovative_research(alliebear),earns_recognition(alliebear)))).

% Alliebear participates in conferences.
axiom(s14, participates_in_conferences(alliebear)).

% Alliebear either gains acclaim or pursues a PhD, but not both.
axiom(s15, xor(gains_acclaim(alliebear),pursues_phd(alliebear))).

% Kyree does not publish her findings.
axiom(s16, not(publishes_findings(kyree))).

% If someone has a creative mind, then they can make breakthroughs.
axiom(s17, rule([has_a_creative_mind(X)], makes_breakthroughs(X))).

% If Alliebear earns recognition, then she either publishes papers or receives awards (or both).
axiom(s18, rule([earns_recognition(alliebear)], or(publishes_papers(alliebear),receives_awards(alliebear)))).

% If Alliebear either receives awards or delivers lectures (but not both), then she gains acclaim.
axiom(s19, rule([xor(receives_awards(alliebear),delivers_lectures(alliebear))], gains_acclaim(alliebear))).

% If Margaret is a dedicated scientist, then she produces innovative research and earns recognition.
axiom(s20, rule([dedicated_scientist(margaret)], and(produces_innovative_research(margaret),earns_recognition(margaret)))).","query":"labelled_explanation(dedicated_scientist(alliebear), Status, Package)"}
